_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Data Management Plan
summary: Describes the organization's processes, procedures, and controls within the DM program, providing the Government a basis for review, evaluation, and monitoring of the DM program and its future workings.
use_relationship:
The Data Management Plan (DMP) describes the organization's processes, procedures, and controls within the DM program. The principal use is to provide the Government a basis for review, evaluation, and monitoring of the DM program and associated future workings.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in GEIA-859 and the principles of GEIA-859-HB (Copies of these standards are available online at www.sae.org or from SAE International, 400 Commonwealth Drive, Warrendale, PA 15096-0001, Tel 877-606-7323 [inside USA and Canada] or 724-776-4970 [outside USA]).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Data Management Plan shall be in contractor's format unless otherwise specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The DMP shall identify the processes and procedures for:

children.title: Data management and planning over the life cycle of a product
Identify Configuration Status Accounting/Integrated Digital Environment (IDE) tools
Physical Handling and Electronic Media (*transportation/delivery of media/receipt and storage)
Data identification throughout the product lifecycle
Unique data document part number assignments
Data management encompasses record control and documentation of the product record and its metadata information to the product's end of life
Establish and maintain a management process for intellectual property, proprietary information, sensitive data, and data rights
Validation of record information establishment and maintenance in the execution of the total data from inception to disposal
